Bill.BriefDescription: Delaying the beginning of regular legislative sessions until March.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the legislature and terms of state officials andmembers of the legislature; amending RCW 44.04.010 and 43.01.010; andadding a new section to chapter 44.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 44.04.010 and 1980 c 87 s 27 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Regular sessions of the legislature shall be held annually,commencing on the second Monday of ((January)) March.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 43.01.010 and 1965 c 8 s 43.01.010 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The governor, lieutenant governor, secretary of state, treasurer,auditor, attorney general, superintendent of public instruction,commissioner of public lands, and insurance commissioner, shall holdoffice for the term of four years, and until their successors areelected and qualified; and the term shall commence on ((the Wednesdayafter)) the second Monday of January following their election.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 44.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) On the second Monday of January of each oddnumbered year, thelegislature shall meet for the following purposes: (a) To judge the election, returns, and qualifications of itsmembers as provided in Article II, section 8 of the state Constitution; (b) To administer the oath of office of such state officers andmembers of the legislature; and (c) To canvass the votes for elected state officers as provided inArticle III, section 4 of the state Constitution. (2) The legislature may also elect its officers and adopt rules ofprocedure at such meeting, but it shall not act on legislation unlessconvened in regular or special session pursuant to Article II, section12 of the state Constitution.
